evidence: In this work, to clear and optimize the surface flattening conditions for the Si,H,/Si(OOl) system in the surface thermal excitation process of the SALE technique, the relation between surface excitation temperature and surface flattening reaction process has been investigated by observing time-dependent dynamic changes in the RHEED patterns during annealing of the S&H,-exposed Si(OO1) surfaces at various temperatures using a charge-coupled device (CCD) camera. The thickness profiles of the growth films were measured by a surface roughness tester.
